topic.original: When does moving fast using AI prototyping of traditional (non-AI) software actually help company, and when does it hurt it? To answer this, look at how Product, Engineering, and Finance short and long term incentives and rewards. To tackle this, map out the following three areas: The Tug-of-War: Chart how Product (wanting features), Engineering (wanting stable code), and Finance (wanting growth per dollar). The Speed Defense: Challenge the idea that technical debt is always a mistake. In highly uncertain markets, is messy code a mandatory tool for survival? The Fix: Propose a realistic way to align these three departments so the company can validate the market without building a technical house of cards.
